conviction_note: The Q3 headline (net profit PLN 198m, cash EBITDA PLN 651m, net debt/cash EBITDA 2.7) has been public since the 16 Oct szacunkowe wyniki, and recoveries and investment since 9 Oct. What the 27 Oct evening report and the next-morning reaction can still carry is how the ~PLN 2.5bn 2026 investment target is handled (YTD PLN 1.21bn, so it is out of reach), any capital-return step the CEO trailed on 16 Oct, and segment and revaluation detail on Spain and Romania. Those cut both ways and roughly cancel, so the findings sum to -0.2 and p_up is 48. abs_move is 6%, well above the ~3% pre-released base, because a guide change is likely, the disclosed short has quadrupled into the print, 20-day realised vol is 37%, and the last two full reports moved -5.85% and -7.68% even with pre-released numbers. The window is AMC, 27 Oct close to 28 Oct close, not the sealed BMO.

already_public.what: Szacunkowe wyniki Q3 2026: net profit PLN 198m (9M PLN 753m vs PLN 877m a year earlier), cash EBITDA PLN 651m (9M PLN 2,052m), net debt/cash EBITDA 2.7; published 17:10 CEST after the session

Q3 operating data: recoveries PLN 960m (-5% y/y, +1% vs accounting plan, 'below operational expectations'), portfolio investment PLN 347m (-44% y/y), 9M investment PLN 1,212m; released 13:23 intraday, stock -7.72% that session and -3.13% the next

2026 portfolio investment guided at about PLN 2.5bn, with management saying the risk of missing it is larger than the chance of beating it

new_in_release.expect: The ~PLN 2.5bn 2026 investment target needs ~PLN 1.29bn in Q4, against PLN 796m in Q4 2025. Expect a cut or a softer formulation in the report or on the call; mildly negative, and partly priced since 9 Oct.

Possible capital-return language or a buyback/payout step, after the CEO said on 16 Oct that surplus capital should go back to shareholders if attractive portfolios are scarce. Positive if it comes, unknown whether it lands in this release.

Final net profit within a whisker of the PLN 198m estimate; the segment and revaluation split (Spain, Romania, Italy, Poland) is new. Romania is likely weak (management has said its macro is worsening).
Q4 supply and competition commentary, plus the October recoveries run-rate on the call. Unknown direction.
Cash EBITDA is already out. Leverage of 2.7x against the larger RCF frames funding capacity; neutral.

findings.finding: The ~PLN 2.5bn 2026 investment target, reaffirmed after H1, is out of reach: 9M spend is PLN 1,212m, so Q4 would need ~PLN 1.29bn against PLN 796m in Q4 2025. The Q3 report or the next-morning call is the first scheduled place for a cut or softer wording.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 27 Aug 2026 the full H1 report, with a pre-released and beaten net profit, fell 7.68% on 'nie urośliśmy tyle, ile chcieliśmy' and an investment target with downside risk. On 9 Oct 2026 the Q3 investment print (-44% y/y) took the stock down 7.72% intraday.
findings.original_quote: Inwestycje będą w okolicy 2,5 mld zł. (Michał Zasępa, board member)
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public and the 9 Oct drop priced the slow pace. What is not priced is a formal reset of the 2026 and 2027 investment ambition, which feeds future ERC and earnings. If it were fully priced, the 16 Oct estimate would have drawn more than -2.1% and sell-side targets would no longer sit at ~PLN 520-530 (PKO BP 523, Citi 525).
findings.independence: The Q4 2025 base of PLN 796m comes from a different document: https://mfn.se/a/kruk/expenditure-on-and-recoveries-from-debt-portfolios-10. The 9M figure is from https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/expenditure-on-and-recoveries-from-debt-portfolios-20261009

findings.finding: On 16 Oct the CEO tied low investment to returning surplus capital to shareholders, so a buyback or payout step could come with the Q3 report or on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: KRUK has never run a buyback (one was proposed in 2019 instead of a dividend). Its record PLN 20/share dividend for 2025 was approved in May 2026; the stock's reaction to the April 2026 dividend recommendation was flat (-0.4% on 9 Apr).
findings.original_quote: jeśli atrakcyjnych portfeli jest mniej, a bilans pozostaje bezpieczny, nadwyżka kapitału powinna wracać do akcjonariuszy
findings.why_not_priced: The statement was buried in the estimate release after the close, and the stock fell 2.1% the next session, so the market read the profit miss and not the capital-return pivot. Had it been priced, the Polish press would carry buyback speculation and the stock would not be at its lowest in ~880 sessions with shorts building.
findings.independence: Same quote in the PAP/xyz feed: https://xyz.pl/?p=263253. It is the flip side of the same low-investment fact as finding 1, and the two are signed in opposite directions on purpose.

findings.finding: Disclosed net short positions in KRUK quadrupled into the print: from one holder at ~0.5% in early September to three quant funds (Two Sigma 0.80%, Qube 0.71%, Marshall Wace 0.70%) totalling 2.21% by 22 Oct, the second-largest disclosed short on GPW.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior KRUK print with a short this size was found. The positions were added after the 9 Oct and 16 Oct releases, during a 35% YTD drawdown.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline has no positioning anchor (KNF register unreachable) and the English wire does not carry this. Systematic shorts are momentum and post-earnings-drift flow rather than fundamental information, so the negative case is already expressed in the price and the crowding is fuel on any non-negative detail. If it had been absorbed, the build would have stopped after 16 Oct rather than continued to 22 Oct.
findings.independence: Comparic independently reports that the short sum has risen since mid-September (snippet only, Cloudflare-blocked): https://comparic.pl/akcje-kruk-odbijaja-po-25-zalamaniu-kurs-najnizej-od-880-sesji-dywidenda-13x-w-gore-w-10-lat-to-juz-okazja/

findings.finding: Five days before the print KRUK raised its syndicated revolver from EUR 755m to EUR 1,020m and extended it to July 2031. That is funding headroom for the seasonally largest Q4 purchase quarter and planned expansion, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The prior annex (30 Oct 2025) came the day after the Q3 2025 report; the stock fell 5.08% on 31 Oct 2025, around the report reaction, so the RCF itself was not separable. On 22 Oct 2026 the stock closed +0.97%.
findings.why_not_priced: It was filed as a routine ESPI notice with no press pickup found. A 35% upsize means banks are underwriting a larger book while the market prices shrinking investment. If it were priced, the narrative would read 'funded for Q4' rather than 'cannot invest'. The money buys portfolio purchases; ND/EBITDA of 2.7x leaves room.

baseline_tension: The lean is +0.33, mean reversion on a -6.6% 20-day run-up, and the findings net to about zero (-0.2). The negative guidance line is offset by a crowded, building short and a trailed capital-return pivot, so the hunt neither confirms nor fights the lean.
language_note: The CEO's capital-return sentence ('nadwyżka kapitału powinna wracać do akcjonariuszy') appears only in the Polish press (Parkiet, PAP via xyz.pl), not in the English MFN estimate release.
The investment target ('Inwestycje będą w okolicy 2,5 mld zł') and the 'risk of missing exceeds chance of beating' framing came from Parkiet's Polish report of the H1 call.

Analyst colour came only from Polish sources: DM BDM called the recovery-to-plan index 'historically low' (101) and said its gross-profit growth assumption 'może wymagać rewizji w dół'; Trigon flagged Romanian one-offs.
The KNF short build came from a Polish-market register mirror (rksgpw.com), which was found through a Polish Comparic snippet.
The English sources (MFN/placera) carried the primary numbers and exact timestamps, which settled the session.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide': the investment-target finding went from -1.0 to -1.5 on the guidance scale, and abs_move_pct from 5.0 to 6.0.
'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': the Romania finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, because its Q3 effect sits inside the pre-released PLN 198m.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction', plus this name falling after full reports (-5.85% Apr, -7.68% Aug 2026): p_up went from 50 to 48 and abs_move was not capped.
'Crowded short is fuel' and 'financing is a question': these confirmed the existing signs on the positioning (+0.5) and RCF (+0.3) findings, so neither moved.
